headline: Appointed John Ellis Stilley as alternate member of the Development Review Board, term expiring 6/30/27.
summary: The agenda and consent agenda were adopted unanimously. The consent agenda included a communication on openings on Burlington city commissions and boards, which was placed on file.
decisions: Appointed John Ellis Stilley as an alternate member of the Development Review Board, term expiring 6/30/27.

decision_evidence.quote: John Ellis Stilley was appointed to the Development Review as an Alternate Member, term expiring 6/30/27.
